<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=5.0, user-scalable=yes">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1677FF">
<style id="newhindimovies-master-css">
:root {
  --c-white: #FFFFFF;
  --c-blue: #1677FF;
  --c-blue-dark: #075DCC;
  --c-blue-soft: #EAF3FF;
  --c-text: #172033;
  --c-text-muted: #53647F;
  --c-border: #DBE9F8;
  --radius: 8px;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
html, body {
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }

.mb-wrap {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 1100px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding: 0 12px !important;
}

/* Header */
.mb-brand {
  position: sticky !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  z-index: 1000 !important;
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--c-blue) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.08) !important;
}
.mb-brand .mb-wrap {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  height: 58px !important;
}
.mb-menu-btn {
  width: 40px !important;
  height: 40px !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 5px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
}
.mb-menu-btn i {
  display: block !important;
  height: 2px !important;
  width: 20px !important;
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  border-radius: 2px !important;
}
.mb-logo {
  text-align: center !important;
  color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  font-size: 20px !important;
  line-height: 1.1 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px !important;
}
.mb-logo small {
  display: block !important;
  color: var(--c-text-muted) !important;
  font-size: 9px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px !important;
  margin-top: 2px !important;
}
.mb-head-search a {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  width: 40px !important;
  height: 40px !important;
  color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  font-size: 22px !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
}

/* Search bar */
.mb-search {
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  padding: 10px 0 !important;
}
.mb-search form {
  display: flex !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}
.mb-search input[type="search"] {
  flex: 1 !important;
  height: 44px !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  padding: 0 14px !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  outline: none !important;
}
.mb-search input[type="search"]:focus {
  border-color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
}
.mb-search input[type="submit"] {
  display: block !important;
  height: 44px !important;
  padding: 0 18px !important;
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
}

/* Telegram CTA */
.mb-telegram-banner-wrap {
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  padding: 10px 12px !important;
}
.mb-telegram-banner {
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--c-blue) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  padding: 10px 14px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  color: var(--c-blue-dark) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
}
.mb-telegram-icon {
  width: 22px !important;
  height: 22px !important;
  flex: 0 0 22px !important;
}
.mb-telegram-btn-txt {
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-white) !important;
  padding: 6px 12px !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* Notice & Breadcrumb */
.mb-notice {
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--c-blue) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  padding: 10px 14px !important;
  margin: 12px auto !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
}
.mb-notice .tag {
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-white) !important;
  padding: 3px 6px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  margin-right: 6px !important;
}
.mb-warning {
  margin-top: 8px !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  color: var(--c-text-muted) !important;
}
.mb-breadcrumb {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  padding: 8px 12px !important;
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  margin: 12px 0 !important;
  color: var(--c-text-muted) !important;
}
.mb-breadcrumb a { color: var(--c-blue) !important; }
.mb-breadcrumb b { color: var(--c-text) !important; }

/* Section Title */
.mb-section-title {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  padding: 9px 12px !important;
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-white) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  margin: 16px 0 12px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
}
.mb-section-title * { color: var(--c-white) !important; }

/* Feature Strip */
.mb-feature-strip {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  margin: 14px 0 !important;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .mb-feature-strip { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; }
}
.mb-feature-item {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
.mb-feature-item img {
  width: 100% !important;
  aspect-ratio: 2 / 3 !important;
  object-fit: cover !important;
}
.mb-feature-title {
  padding: 7px 8px !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
  white-space: normal !important;
  line-height: 1.3 !important;
}

/* Movie Card Grid: 2 columns mobile, 4 columns desktop */
.mb-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .mb-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; gap: 14px !important; }
}
.mb-card {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.05) !important;
  transition: transform 0.15s, border-color 0.15s !important;
}
.mb-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}
.mb-poster {
  position: relative !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  aspect-ratio: 2 / 3 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
}
.mb-poster img {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  object-fit: cover !important;
}
.mb-quality {
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 6px !important;
  left: 6px !important;
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-white) !important;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  padding: 2px 6px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
}
.mb-card-body {
  padding: 8px 10px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  flex-grow: 1 !important;
}
.mb-card-title {
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
  display: -webkit-box !important;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2 !important;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
.mb-card-meta {
  font-size: 11px !important;
  color: var(--c-text-muted) !important;
  margin-top: 4px !important;
}

/* Category Folders */
.mb-folder-list {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 7px !important;
}
.mb-folder {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  padding: 10px 14px !important;
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--c-blue) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
}
.mb-folder:hover, .mb-folder:active {
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  border-color: var(--c-blue) !important;
}
.mb-folder small {
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  padding: 3px 8px !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
}

/* Pagination */
.mb-pager {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  margin: 20px 0 !important;
}
.mb-pager a, .mb-pager span, .mb-pager b {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  min-width: 36px !important;
  height: 36px !important;
  padding: 0 10px !important;
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
}
.mb-pager a:hover {
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  border-color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-blue) !important;
}
.mb-pager a:first-child, .mb-pager b, .mb-pager .active {
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  border-color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-white) !important;
}

/* Download Page */
.mb-download-page { padding: 8px 0 24px !important; }
.mb-movie-card {
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  padding: 14px !important;
}
.mb-movie-hero {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 14px !important;
  margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}
@media (min-width: 650px) {
  .mb-movie-hero { flex-direction: row !important; align-items: flex-start !important; }
}
.mb-poster-wrap {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 240px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  aspect-ratio: 2 / 3 !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  position: relative !important;
}
.mb-movie-poster {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  object-fit: cover !important;
}
.mb-poster-badge {
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 8px !important;
  left: 8px !important;
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-white) !important;
  font-size: 9px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  padding: 3px 6px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
}
.mb-movie-info { flex: 1 !important; }
.mb-kicker {
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px !important;
  margin-bottom: 4px !important;
}
.mb-movie-info h1 {
  font-size: 18px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
  line-height: 1.3 !important;
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
}
.mb-meta-line {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  color: var(--c-text-muted) !important;
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
}
.mb-meta-line b { color: var(--c-text) !important; }
.mb-feature-row {
  display: flex !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
}
.mb-chip {
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  color: var(--c-blue-dark) !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  padding: 3px 8px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
}
.mb-intro {
  font-size: 13px !important;
  color: var(--c-text-muted) !important;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
}

/* Quality download list */
.mb-quality-list {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  margin: 14px 0 !important;
}
.mb-quality-row {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  padding: 13px 16px !important;
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-white) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.25) !important;
}
.mb-quality-row:hover, .mb-quality-row:active {
  background: var(--c-blue-dark) !important;
}
.mb-quality-row b { font-size: 14px !important; font-weight: 800 !important; }
.mb-quality-row small { display: block !important; font-size: 11px !important; opacity: 0.85 !important; }
.mb-quality-row strong { font-size: 13px !important; font-weight: 800 !important; }

.mb-terabox-note {
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
  border: 1px dashed var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-blue-dark) !important;
  padding: 10px 14px !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  margin: 12px 0 16px !important;
}
.mb-media-card {
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  padding: 8px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}
.mb-description {
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  padding: 14px !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  line-height: 1.6 !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
}
.mb-download-help {
  margin-top: 18px !important;
  padding-top: 14px !important;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
}
.mb-download-actions {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  margin-top: 10px !important;
}
.mb-download-actions a, .mb-download-cta {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  padding: 9px 14px !important;
  background: var(--c-blue) !important;
  color: var(--c-white) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* Drawer / Browser Menu */
.mb-browser-menu {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 99999;
}
.mb-browser-menu.is-open { display: block; }
.mb-browser-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(7, 93, 204, 0.35);
  backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
}
.mb-browser-panel {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: min(300px, 86vw);
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--c-white);
  border-right: 2px solid var(--c-border);
  box-shadow: 10px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.mb-browser-head {
  padding: 16px;
  background: var(--c-blue-soft);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}
.mb-browser-head b { font-size: 16px; color: var(--c-blue); font-weight: 900; }
.mb-browser-head small { font-size: 9px; color: var(--c-text-muted); display: block; }
.mb-browser-head button {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--c-white);
  color: var(--c-blue);
  font-size: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.mb-browser-label {
  padding: 10px 14px;
  background: var(--c-blue);
  color: var(--c-white);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.mb-browser-list { padding: 8px 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.mb-browser-folder {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  padding: 10px 12px !important;
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
}
.mb-browser-extra {
  padding: 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}
.mb-browser-extra a {
  padding: 9px 12px;
  background: var(--c-blue-soft);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--c-blue-dark) !important;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Legal Pages */
.mb-legal-page { padding: 14px 0 30px !important; }
.mb-legal-card {
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  border-radius: var(--radius) !important;
  padding: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1.65 !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
}
.mb-legal-card h1, .mb-legal-card h2 {
  color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  margin: 14px 0 6px !important;
}
.mb-legal-card p, .mb-legal-card li {
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
}

/* Footer */
.mb-footer {
  background: var(--c-white) !important;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  padding: 24px 0 !important;
  margin-top: 30px !important;
  text-align: center !important;
}
.mb-footer-copy {
  font-size: 14px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--c-text) !important;
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
}
.mb-footer-copy b { color: var(--c-blue) !important; }
.mb-footer-tags {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 8px 14px !important;
  margin-bottom: 18px !important;
}
.mb-footer-tags a {
  color: var(--c-blue) !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}
.mb-footer-seo {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border) !important;
  padding-top: 14px !important;
  margin-top: 14px !important;
}
.mb-footer-seo-title {
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--c-text-muted) !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}
.mb-footer-tags-cloud {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
}
.mb-footer-tags-cloud a {
  padding: 5px 9px !important;
  background: var(--c-blue-soft) !important;
